title: Mai Rarraba Hikima Mara Dorewa
intro: Mutum mai daraja, wanda aka san shi da zurfin fahimta da kuma shawarwari masu kyau, ya taɓa ba da shawara da ta wuce tsararraki. Kalmominsu, waɗanda aka rubuta a cikin littafi mai tsarki, suna shiryar da mutane zuwa ga godiya, haƙuri, da kuma ɗabi'a mai kyau.
clues: An albarkace ni da hikima, ba annabci ba.
Na yi wa ɗana wasiyya kan mafi girman zunubai: haɗa Allah da wani.
Na koyar game da nauyin ayyuka, har ma da darajar ƙwayar mustard, da kuma yadda Allah zai fitar da ita.
Na jaddada godiya ga Allah da kuma iyayen mutum, ina kuma godiya ga wahalar da ake sha wajen renon yaro.
Shawarata ta haɗa da tsayar da sallah, umarni da alheri, hana mugunta, da kuma jure wa abin da ya same mutum cikin haƙuri.
An sanya wa wani babi a cikin Alqur'ani suna bayana, wanda ya ƙunshi koyarwara da darussan da na raba.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An ba shi dukiya mai yawa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
